verification.validation: Focused response and diagnostic regressions, request-only persistence and replay checks, Go package tests and build, frontend tests/typecheck/build, Node and Python adapter tests, and native Rust container tests/build validate this patch. Executor sources and canonical tasks are unchanged; the immutable executor/v0.49.5 inventory is reused. No publication or NAS acceptance is implied.

changes: Preserve client response results and public error code, message and details without field-name or credential-value redaction, including request-only routes and frontend transport errors.
Keep request-only credentials out of SDK background stores and notification journals, consume frontend wrappers once and prevent automatic replay.
Limit diagnostic field matching to exact credential names and explicitly declared application fields; preserve sidebar, tokenCount, secretName and otpEnabled.
Keep redacted stderr diagnostics in Node, Python and Rust while preserving their existing client error behavior.
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.49.5 release and its six digests.
